Our Museum On-the-Go educators travel directly to schools and community centers with portable, hands-on experiences and activity kits designed to turn any space into an interactive learning environment. With programs designed to engage 2 year olds to 5th graders, there’s fun to discover for everyone! Museum On-the-Go sessions run 30-60 minutes and are available Monday through Friday.
